Enrico is a survivor. At the age of 23, he 
suffered a traumatic brain injury following a 
motorcycle accident that left him ina coma 
for two weeks. Enrico miraculously survived, 
but two years of rehabilitation were needed 
to relearn how to walk, talk, and function. 
His story seems hard to believe when you 
meet Enrico, who is now a CEGEP teacher, 

a doctoral student and trainer, as well as 

a seasoned triathlete. 


Enrico’s recovery can be credited to his 
incredible medical team. And also to 
the Y, where he began exercising again 
and where he found a family to support 
him during critical moments in his life. 
This led him to develop an exercise 
program for people who, like him, have 
suffered head trauma. His goal: to help 
them become active members of their 
community again. 


inks to you, thousands of individuals participate 
YMCA’s various physical activities and feel 
better in their bodies, minds and hearts - no matter 
their age, no matter their motivation! Like Enrico, 
they feel welcome, build positive relationships and 
develop a strong sense of belonging to their Y.

Clara is a ray of sunshine. A playful, lively little 
girl. A little girl with an invisible handicap: 
dyspraxia combined with ADHD. 


Clara and her family endured many 
challenging summers in various day camps. 
Every day was a battle. Clara didn't like any 
of them - either she didn’t make friends or 
she wasn't properly supported. Her parents 
always ended up withdrawing her. 


Everything changed when they found a YMCA Day 
Camp. Clara was paired with a dedicated companion 
who met her different needs and ensured that she 
participated in the group's regular activities. It was a 
great comfort. 


Her companion helped Clara gain self-confidence, 
push her boundaries and create bonds, in a safe 
environment. “It was a relief to see our daughter 


|“ 


enjoying her summer. Finally! 


The news reminds us every day that many children and adults suffer from exclusion. By supporting 
us, you make YMCA programs accessible to as many people as possible. You make a huge difference 
that directly impacts children as well as the quality of life of entire families like Clara’s. 


“| know what it feels like to be alone. At 
school, | was bullied and discriminated 
against. | was ignored because | was shy. 
My mother was in a difficult financial 
situation and | had lost my uncle, who 
was like my father. 


They say there are two things you need 
to survive high school: friends and adults 
who support you, no matter what. | found 
both at C-Vert. The program gave me 
everything | was looking for. 


A place where | could start over again 
and make real friends, away from all 
the drama at school. A place where 

| learned so much with people who 
really cared. A place where | could 
simply be myself. 


| always knew that | wanted to make 
a difference, but | didn’t know how. 
Today, | want to use’ the media as a 
tool to educate young people about 
socio-environmental issues.” 


“| WOULD NOT BE WHO! AM 
WITHOUT THIS Y PROGRAM. 


CVERT HAS BEEN AT THE HEART OF 
SO MANY KEY MOMENTS IN MY LIFE. 


LIKE A PARENT WHO HELPS THEIR CHILD 
DISCOVER ALL THE POTENTIAL THAT LIES 
WITHIN THEM.” 


Elijah, participant in the C-Vert 
Environmental Engagement Program, 
standing in front of a mural created 


Your support for the YMCA by C-Vert youth. 
gives young people who are 
going through a difficult time, 
a safe place to meet, build 
friendships, and grow together 
by simply being themselves 

— without any judgement. 

“A heaven that makes life less 
rough,’ as Elijah would say.

At the YMCAs of Québec Foundation, 
we are here to help you achieve your 
dreams by connecting your interests 
to the needs of the community and 
by advancing our shared vision for 
our world! }° 
wee" 
You may have always dreamed of 
reducing school dropout rates, getting 
teens off the street, helping families in 
need, or improving people's health and 
quality of life. By choosing to support 
the YMCA, you are changing the lives 
of people, families and communities. 


Thank you for supporting us - and 

them - through all of your energy, 
commitment and heart. Together, we 
are building stronger, more harmonious 
communities. Communities where 
everyone is free to be themselves 

and reach their full potential. You 

are offering each and every person 

a springboard for an active, healthy, 
engaged and fulfilling life. 


Through the generosity 
of more than 2,500 donors.

youth and families in Québec.

“There is a ten-year difference 
in the life expectancy of 
residents in Hochelaga- 
Maisonneuve and those in 
Dorval. | do not accept that 
a child's postal code has 
more influence on their 
future than their genetic 
code. The Y acts on this: 

it welcomes children from 
all walks of life and builds 
bridges between them.’ 
Sophie Brochu, 


President and CEO, Energir, 
and Honorary 2018 Laureate

values make it a unique partner, 
a partner that furthers our 
commitment to support the 
development of youth from 
all walks of life.” 


Guy Cormier, President and Chief 
Executive Officer of Desjardins Group 


On behalf of the thousands of young 
people who will benefit from this 
contribution, we thank Desjardins 
for building stronger communities 
and supporting youth success with 
the YMCA. 


Your support represents an investment in our TeenZones, more 
importantly an investment in the lives of our young participants: 
Abdullah, Alamine, Ali, Daniel, Erik, Evans, Jade, Jean-Marie, 
Methula, Nathanial, Radhika, Shannon, Socrates, and many 
others. Thank you also to all the laureates for inspiring us.

in a young person's life. It is what every young

Relationships are at the heart of what children need to learn, 
grow and thrive. The evidence is unequivocal: successful children 
have often benefitted from at least one stable and engaged 
relationship with a caring adult — be it a mentor, a youth worker, 
a teacher or a volunteer.
